cs.t: I have an HP Envy 13 that I bought mainly for the specs/price.  But I was pleantly surprised with the build quality, very quiet fans but good thermals, and keyboard.  Runs Ubuntu 16.04 without issue. For $850 (on sale) the specs cannot be beat, 4k touchscreen,  4 core i7-8th gen, 16gb ram, 512GB nvme ssd, and dedicated NVidia GPU. My only complaint is that it charges via barrel pin instead of USB-C. Here’s where I bought it, but I got it from their ebay storefront with a coupon or something:  https://www.adorama.com/ihp1kt13uar.html
